prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The survey of only ten students _____ that most teenagers prefer online classes.
options: cannot prove
proves beyond doubt
must have proved
answer: cannot prove

wrong.proves beyond doubt: 樣本只有十人，不足以下定論；beyond doubt 語氣太絕對。
wrong.must have proved: must have 是對過去的肯定推測，語氣過強，與小樣本的限制不符。

why: 樣本太小，只能說「無法證明」，不能把結果推廣到所有青少年。
tip: 小樣本不足以證明，用 cannot prove 較穩妥。
say: The survey of only ten students cannot prove that most teenagers prefer online classes.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise together, so ice cream causes drowning.
Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise together, but this does not mean one causes the other.
Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise together, so they are cause.
answer: Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise together, but this does not mean one causes the other.

wrong.Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise: 把相關當成因果；兩者同時上升可能是因為夏天天氣熱。
cause 是名詞或動詞，這裡文法不通順，也沒有說明因果是否成立。

why: 同時上升只是相關，不代表一個導致另一個。
tip: 相關不等於因果，先找第三個因素。
say: Ice-cream sales and drowning cases rise together, but this does not mean one causes the other.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你想委婉地說：這份報告的結論，可能高估了回收的效果。
options: The conclusion is totally wrong about recycling.
The conclusion may overstate the recycling benefit of.
The conclusion may overstate the benefit of recycling.
The conclusion overstated may the benefit of recycling.
answer: The conclusion may overstate the benefit of recycling.

wrong.The conclusion is totally wrong about re: 語氣太直接，也沒有說明問題在哪裡，不適合學術討論。
wrong.The conclusion may overstate the recycli: 詞序錯誤，of 不能放在句尾。
wrong.The conclusion overstated may the benefi: may 要放在動詞原形前，不能放在 overstated 後面。

why: may overstate 是委婉的限定語氣，適合提出質疑。
tip: 想委婉質疑，用 may 加動詞原形。
say: The conclusion may overstate the benefit of recycling.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: The data is suggestive, not conclusive.
options: 資料已經百分之百證明
資料完全沒有用處
資料是由別人偷偷提供的
資料有些跡象，但還不能下定論
answer: 資料有些跡象，但還不能下定論

wrong.資料已經百分之百證明: conclusive 是「決定性的」，句中用 not 否定它。
wrong.資料完全沒有用處: suggestive 表示有提示價值，並非毫無用處。
wrong.資料是由別人偷偷提供的: 與 suggestive 的字義無關，是望文生義。

why: suggestive 表示「有暗示性」，not conclusive 表示「還不能確定」。
tip: suggestive 有線索，conclusive 才是定論。
say: The data is suggestive, not conclusive.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: It is the lack of public transport _____ makes many commuters drive to work.
options: that
what
where
it
answer: that

wrong.what: what 本身包含先行詞，不能接在 transport 後面當關係詞連接。
wrong.where: 強調句型 It is ... that 裡，that 之前不用 where，這裡也不是地點。
wrong.it: 再放一個 it 會變成重複主詞，文法不通。

why: It is ... that ... 是強調句型，that 引導被強調部分之後的內容。
tip: 強調句型固定用 It is ... that ...。
say: It is the lack of public transport that makes many commuters drive to work.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: It was last year what the city banned plastic bags.
It was last year that the city banned plastic bags.
It was last year the city that banned plastic bags.
It last year was that the city banned plastic bags.
answer: It was last year that the city banned plastic bags.

wrong.It was last year what the city banned pl: 強調句型要用 that，不是 what。
wrong.It was last year the city that banned pl: that 放錯位置，會讓強調的對象變成 the city，意思被改變。
wrong.It last year was that the city banned pl: was 要放在 It 後面，詞序錯誤。

why: 強調時間用 It was + 時間 + that + 句子。
tip: 強調句型：It was X that ...。
say: It was last year that the city banned plastic bags.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The committee recommended that every school _____ solar panels by 2030.
options: installs
installed
install
will install
answer: install

wrong.installs: recommend that 之後用假設語氣，動詞用原形，不加 s。
wrong.installed: recommend that 之後要用原形動詞，不是過去式。
wrong.will install: 建議的內容要用原形動詞，而不是 will 加動詞。

why: recommend、suggest、demand 後的 that 子句用原形動詞。
tip: recommend that 後面接原形動詞。
say: The committee recommended that every school install solar panels by 2030.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 同學說：「這個研究只訪問了一所學校，所以不能代表全台灣。」你想用英文同意他。
options: Right, the sample is too wide to generalize.
Right, we should generalize it to everyone.
Right, the sample proves everything.
Right, the sample is too narrow to generalize.
answer: Right, the sample is too narrow to generalize.

wrong.Right, the sample is too wide to general: 一所學校是窄，不是 wide，與同學的說法相反。
wrong.Right, we should generalize it to everyo: 同學的重點是不應該推廣，這句剛好相反。
一所學校的樣本無法證明一切，語氣太絕對。

why: narrow 表示範圍狹小，generalize 表示把結論推廣到所有人。
tip: 樣本太窄，就不能隨便推廣。
say: Right, the sample is too narrow to generalize.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: sustainable
options: 能長久維持而不耗盡資源的
很快就會消失的
價格非常便宜的
只在夏天使用的
answer: 能長久維持而不耗盡資源的

wrong.很快就會消失的: 與 sustainable 相反，那是 short-lived 之類的意思。
wrong.價格非常便宜的: sustainable 說的是能否持續，不是價格。

why: sustainable 指在不破壞環境與資源的前提下可以持續。
tip: sustain 是維持，sustainable 是可長久維持。
say: This is a sustainable way to use water.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Use more electric buses may reduce air pollution.
Using more electric buses may reduce air pollution.
Using more electric buses may reduces air pollution.
Using more electric buses may reduce of air pollution.
answer: Using more electric buses may reduce air pollution.

wrong.Use more electric buses may reduce air p: 動詞 use 不能直接當主詞，要用 Using 或 To use。
wrong.Using more electric buses may reduces ai: may 後面要接動詞原形，不能寫 reduces。
wrong.Using more electric buses may reduce of: reduce 是及物動詞，後面不需要 of。

why: 動名詞 Using 可當主詞，may 後接原形動詞 reduce。
tip: 動詞當主詞要改成 -ing；may 後接原形。
say: Using more electric buses may reduce air pollution.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Factories must find ways to cut _____ of carbon dioxide.
options: emotions
admissions
emissions
missions
answer: emissions

wrong.emotions: 拼字相近但意思是情緒，與二氧化碳無關。
wrong.admissions: 意思是入學或承認，不是排放。

why: emissions 是「排放物」，常與 carbon dioxide 搭配。
tip: emission 是排放，注意不要與 emotion 混淆。
say: Factories must find ways to cut emissions of carbon dioxide.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 老師問你的看法，你想說：「這個方法有幫助，但我們需要更多證據。」
options: The method seems helpful, but we need much evidences.
The method seems helpfully, but we need more evidence.
The method seem helpful, but we need more evidence.
The method seems helpful, but we need more evidence.
answer: The method seems helpful, but we need more evidence.

wrong.The method seems helpful, but we need mu: evidence 是不可數名詞，沒有 evidences，也不能用 much 搭配複數。
wrong.The method seems helpfully, but we need: seem 後面要接形容詞 helpful，不是副詞 helpfully。
wrong.The method seem helpful, but we need mor: 主詞 method 是單數，動詞要用 seems。

why: seems helpful 加上 more evidence，語氣謹慎。
tip: evidence 不可數，不加 s。
say: The method seems helpful, but we need more evidence.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: The report acknowledges several limitations.
options: 報告承認有幾項不足之處
報告禁止了幾項計畫
報告獲得了多項獎勵
報告否認有任何問題
answer: 報告承認有幾項不足之處

wrong.報告禁止了幾項計畫: limitations 是「限制、不足」，不是禁止。
wrong.報告否認有任何問題: acknowledge 與 deny 相反，剛好說反了。

why: acknowledge 是承認，limitation 是研究的限制或不足。
tip: 研究報告常會寫出 limitations。
say: The report acknowledges several limitations.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Researchers warn that the results should be interpreted with _____.
options: cautious
caution
cautiously
careless
answer: caution

wrong.cautious: 介系詞 with 後面要接名詞 caution，不是形容詞。
wrong.cautiously: with 後面接名詞，副詞放在這裡文法錯誤。
wrong.careless: careless 是粗心，意思相反，也不是名詞。

why: with caution 是固定用法，表示「小心謹慎地」。
tip: with caution：介系詞後面接名詞。
say: The results should be interpreted with caution.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Not only the plan saves money, but it also protects the forest.
Not only does the plan saves money, but it also protects the forest.
Not only does the plan save money, but it also protects the forest.
Not only the plan does save money, but it also protects the forest.
answer: Not only does the plan save money, but it also protects the forest.

wrong.Not only the plan saves money, but it al: Not only 放句首時，後面要倒裝成 does the plan save。
wrong.Not only does the plan saves money, but: does 後面的動詞要用原形 save。
wrong.Not only the plan does save money, but i: 助動詞 does 要放在主詞 the plan 前面。

why: Not only 放句首時，後面是倒裝句：Not only does + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
tip: Not only 開頭要倒裝。
say: Not only does the plan save money, but it also protects the forest.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 朋友說：「電動車完全不會造成污染。」你想提醒他發電也可能產生污染。
options: Well, it depends on how the electricity produces.
Well, it is depended on how the electricity is produced.
Well, it depend on how the electricity is produced.
Well, it depends on how the electricity is produced.
answer: Well, it depends on how the electricity is produced.

wrong.Well, it depends on how the electricity: electricity 是被產生的，要用被動 is produced。
wrong.Well, it is depended on how the electric: depend 是不及物動詞，沒有被動，應寫 it depends on。
wrong.Well, it depend on how the electricity i: it 是第三人稱單數，depend 要加 s。

why: it depends on ... 用來提醒結論要看條件，並指出限制。
tip: it depends on 是不及物，不用被動。
say: Well, it depends on how the electricity is produced.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: mitigate
options: 減輕（損害或影響）
加重
忽略
證明
answer: 減輕（損害或影響）

wrong.忽略: 忽略是 ignore；mitigate 是主動讓情況變輕。
wrong.證明: 證明是 prove；mitigate 與證明無關。

why: mitigate 常見搭配：mitigate the effects of climate change。
tip: mitigate = 減輕，常搭配 effects。
say: Trees can help mitigate the effects of heat in cities.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The new law is a good start, but it is not a _____ solution.
options: completely
complete
completion
complex
answer: complete

wrong.completely: 空格在 a 與 solution 之間，需要形容詞，不能用副詞。
wrong.completion: completion 是名詞「完成」，不能修飾 solution。
wrong.complex: 拼字相似但意思是複雜，不符合「完整」的語意。

why: complete 當形容詞修飾名詞 solution，表示「完整的」。
tip: 名詞前面用形容詞，不用副詞。
say: The new law is not a complete solution.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The study failed to take in account differences in income.
The study failed taking into account differences in income.
The study failed to take into account differences in income.
The study failed to take into account of differences in income.
answer: The study failed to take into account differences in income.

wrong.The study failed to take in account diff: take into account 是固定片語，介系詞是 into。
wrong.The study failed taking into account dif: fail 後面要接 to 不定詞，不接 -ing。
wrong.The study failed to take into account of: take into account 後面直接接受詞，不加 of。

why: take ... into account 是「把……考慮進去」，fail to 之後接原形。
tip: fail to + 原形；take into account。
say: The study failed to take into account differences in income.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: The evidence is anecdotal.
options: 證據來自大規模實驗
證據非常古老
證據已被政府公開
證據只是個人經驗，不夠嚴謹
answer: 證據只是個人經驗，不夠嚴謹

wrong.證據來自大規模實驗: anecdotal 是軼事式的，指個別經驗，不是大規模實驗。
wrong.證據已被政府公開: anecdotal 與政府公開沒有關係。

why: anecdotal 指依據個別故事或經驗，缺乏系統性資料。
tip: anecdotal evidence 不能代表整體。
say: The evidence is anecdotal.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你要補充一個限制，說：「這項調查只包含城市居民。」
options: The survey included only urban residents.
The survey included urban residents only of.
The survey included only urban resident.
The survey is included only urban residents.
answer: The survey included only urban residents.

wrong.The survey included urban residents only: only of 放在句尾不通順，位置也不對。
residents 在此是複數，單數 resident 與句意不符。
wrong.The survey is included only urban reside: include 在這裡是主動，不要用 is included。

why: only 放在被限定的詞前，清楚說明限制範圍。
tip: only 放在被限制的詞前面。
say: The survey included only urban residents.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Recycling alone is not enough; _____, we also need to reduce waste.
options: for example
in other words
by contrast
at first
answer: in other words

wrong.for example: 後面不是舉例，而是進一步補充說明。
wrong.by contrast: by contrast 表示對比，這句並沒有對比關係。
wrong.at first: at first 是「起初」，不是補充說明。

why: 前句說光靠回收不夠，後句換個方式補充說明，所以用 in other words。
tip: in other words 引導換句話說。
say: Recycling alone is not enough; in other words, we also need to reduce waste.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: If the government acted earlier, the damage would have been smaller.
Had the government acted earlier, the damage would be smaller.
Had the government acted earlier, the damage would have been smaller.
Did the government act earlier, the damage would have been smaller.
answer: Had the government acted earlier, the damage would have been smaller.

wrong.If the government acted earlier, the dam: 與過去事實相反要用 had acted，不是 acted。
wrong.Had the government acted earlier, the da: 過去事實的結果要搭配 would have been，不是 would be。
wrong.Did the government act earlier, the dama: 省略 if 的倒裝只能用 had，不能用 did。

why: 假設過去相反的事實：Had + 主詞 + p.p., would have p.p.。
tip: 過去相反：Had S p.p., S would have p.p.。
say: Had the government acted earlier, the damage would have been smaller.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: trade-off
options: 完全免費的交易
一種新的貿易政策
雙方一致同意
為了得到一些好處而必須放棄另一些
answer: 為了得到一些好處而必須放棄另一些

wrong.完全免費的交易: trade-off 不是免費，而是有取捨。
wrong.一種新的貿易政策: trade-off 是取捨，不是特定的貿易政策。

why: trade-off 指兩種好處無法兩全，必須取捨。
tip: trade-off = 取捨。
say: There is a trade-off between speed and safety.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你想表示這個結論可能只適用於特定年齡層。
options: This finding may apply only to certain age groups.
This finding may applies only to certain age groups.
This finding may apply only for certain age groups.
This finding may apply only to a certain age group of.
answer: This finding may apply only to certain age groups.

wrong.This finding may applies only to certain: may 後面要用原形動詞 apply。
wrong.This finding may apply only for certain: apply to 才是固定搭配，不是 apply for。
wrong.This finding may apply only to a certain: of 放在句尾沒有意義，文法錯誤。

why: apply to 是「適用於」，may 表示可能性，語氣謹慎。
tip: apply to = 適用於。
say: This finding may apply only to certain age groups.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The company claims that its products are eco-friendly, but there is little _____ to support this.
options: evident
evidence
evidently
evidences
answer: evidence

wrong.evident: evident 是形容詞，little 後面要接名詞。
wrong.evidently: evidently 是副詞，不能接在 little 後面。
wrong.evidences: evidence 不可數，沒有複數形。

why: little 後接不可數名詞 evidence。
tip: little evidence：不可數。
say: There is little evidence to support the claim.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Although the results look promising, but further research is needed.
Despite the results look promising, further research is needed.
Although the results look promising, further research is needed.
Although the results looks promising, further research is needed.
answer: Although the results look promising, further research is needed.

wrong.Although the results look promising, but: although 與 but 不能同時連接同一句，二選一。
wrong.Despite the results look promising, furt: despite 後面要接名詞或 -ing，不能接完整句子。
wrong.Although the results looks promising, fu: results 是複數，動詞要用 look。

why: although 引導讓步子句，句中不再加 but。
tip: although 和 but 不並用。
say: Although the results look promising, further research is needed.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
text: The author hedges her claim by using "tends to".
options: 作者用 tends to 讓語氣更強烈
作者用 tends to 表達自己害怕
作者用 tends to 表示結論一定正確
作者用 tends to 讓語氣不那麼絕對
answer: 作者用 tends to 讓語氣不那麼絕對

wrong.作者用 tends to 讓語氣更強烈: hedge 是緩和語氣，tends to 反而降低絕對性。
wrong.作者用 tends to 表達自己害怕: hedge 與恐懼無關，是語氣上的保留。
wrong.作者用 tends to 表示結論一定正確: tends to 表示傾向，不是保證。

why: hedge 是用緩和詞語避免說得太滿。
tip: tends to、may 都是緩和語氣。
say: The author hedges her claim.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The more energy we save, _____ our bills will be.
options: the lower
the lowest
lower
the low
answer: the lower

wrong.the lowest: the + 比較級 ... the + 比較級，不用最高級。
wrong.lower: 雙重比較結構中第二部分也需要 the。
wrong.the low: 這裡要比較級 lower，不是原級。

why: The more ..., the + 比較級 ... 表示「越……越……」。
tip: 越……越……：the + 比較級。
say: The more energy we save, the lower our bills will be.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你想問對方：「你的資料是從哪裡來的？」
options: Where you did get your data from?
Where did you get your data from?
Where did you got your data from?
Where did you get your datas from?
answer: Where did you get your data from?

wrong.Where you did get your data from?: 疑問句要把助動詞 did 放在主詞前面。
wrong.Where did you got your data from?: did 後面的動詞要用原形 get。
wrong.Where did you get your datas from?: data 在此當集合名詞，不加 s。

why: 詢問資料來源，是檢查證據可靠度的好習慣。
tip: 疑問句：疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 原形。
say: Where did you get your data from?

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Whether the policy works depend on how people respond.
That the policy works depends on how people respond.
Whether the policy works depends on how people respond.
Whether the policy works depends of how people respond.
answer: Whether the policy works depends on how people respond.

wrong.Whether the policy works depend on how p: 主詞是 Whether 子句，視為單數，動詞用 depends。
wrong.That the policy works depends on how peo: that 子句無法表示「是否」的語意，與原意不同。
wrong.Whether the policy works depends of how: depend 的搭配介系詞是 on，不是 of。

why: Whether 子句當主詞，表示「是否」，視為單數。
tip: Whether 子句當主詞，動詞用單數。
say: Whether the policy works depends on how people respond.

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。

moreover

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。

prompt: 這句話（或這個字）在句中是什麼意思？
